title: Answer architecture
fallback: Illustrative structure: an agent uses evidence from sources and tools, then presents an answer through native components or a sandbox. These are responsibilities, not timing measurements.

props.css: #architecture{display:grid;gap:16px;min-width:0}#architecture p{margin:0}#architecture .diagram-context{color:var(--color-text-secondary);font-size:13px}#architecture svg{display:none;width:100%;overflow:visible}#architecture.diagram-ready svg{display:block}#architecture svg text{font:500 13px var(--font-sans);fill:var(--color-text-primary);text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:middle}#architecture .edge{fill:none;stroke:var(--color-text-secondary);stroke-width:1.5}#architecture .arrowhead{fill:var(--color-text-secondary)}#architecture .vertex{cursor:pointer}#architecture .vertex rect{fill:var(--color-background-secondary);stroke:var(--color-border-secondary);stroke-width:1}#architecture .vertex[aria-pressed=true] rect,#architecture .vertex:focus-visible rect{stroke:var(--color-text-info);stroke-width:2}#architecture .vertex:focus-visible{outline:none}#architecture .node-detail{display:grid;gap:4px;min-height:64px}#architecture .node-detail span{color:var(--color-text-secondary)}#architecture .architecture-list{display:grid;gap:8px}#architecture.diagram-ready .architecture-list{display:none}@media(max-width:540px){#architecture.diagram-ready .architecture-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}#architecture .architecture-list button{width:100%;text-align:start}}
